entities.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
aliases: the young khan of the Mardu
entities.description: The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan who won her war name at sixteen and defeats dragons in battle; she is called a boy by some but knows who she is.

entities.name: Gedruk Wingbreaker
entities.description: An orc warrior who delivers the killing blow to a dragon after another orc holds back.

entities.name: Kuru Vashar
entities.description: A warrior saved by the nameless orc when a dragon fell on her.

entities.name: Magran Backbreaker
entities.description: A warrior whom the nameless orc shielded from a dragon's claw.

entities.name: Jalasha Impaler
entities.description: A warrior whose life the nameless orc saved by leaping onto a dragon's head.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The dominant dragon whose brood the Mardu hunt and who spawned the dragon that scarred Alesha.

entities.name: Kolaghan's brood
entities.description: Four-winged lightning-breathing dragons that attack the Mardu in the canyon and are killed.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The warrior clan of humans, orcs, and goblins whose members earn war names by killing enemies.

entities.name: Woe-reapers
entities.description: Mardu who chant ancient rites over the dead to keep them still in death.

entities.name: War name
entities.description: The name a Mardu warrior earns by proving themselves in a brutal act of honor, usually killing an enemy.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the Mardu fight dragons.

entities.name: The canyon
entities.description: The canyon with bluffs where the Mardu ambush Kolaghan's brood.

events.summary: Alesha leads the Mardu horde in an ambush of six dragons from Kolaghan's brood in a canyon.
events.quote: Her arrow struck the first one in the mouth, sending a stray bolt of lightning harmlessly to the ground.

events.summary: Mardu warriors drop from a bluff onto the swerving dragon and two drive swords deep into its flesh.
events.quote: But two Mardu—two who would be celebrated this night—drove swords into its flesh

events.summary: A dragon's lightning breath terrifies Alesha, recalling the scars on her back from an earlier dragon, and she leaps from her horse.
events.quote: a memory of past terror, when another spawn of Kolaghan's brood had given her the scars she wore on her back.

events.summary: A towering nameless orc stuns a dragon but holds back instead of killing it, and Gedruk Wingbreaker delivers the killing blow.
events.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

events.summary: Alesha confronts the orc about holding back; he insults her as a human boy who thinks he is a woman.
events.quote: A human boy who thinks he's a woman?

events.summary: In a flashback, sixteen-year-old Alesha kills her first dragon with a spear and names herself Alesha, her grandmother's name, before the old khan and the horde.
events.quote: she pulled a spear from a dead man's back and plunged it into the beast's mouth, up into its brain.

events.summary: In the flashback, the old khan and horde shout Alesha's name without hesitation.
events.quote: And the whole gathered horde shouted "Alesha!" in reply.

events.summary: Alesha kills another dragon with a swing of her sword while it lunges at the nameless orc, and tells him to show who he is.
events.quote: I know who I am," Alesha said to him, still smiling. "Now show me who you are."

events.summary: The orc fights unorthodoxly, battering the dragon and making openings for allies, and the six dragons die at great cost.
events.quote: Six of Kolaghan's brood would never prey on the Mardu again.

events.summary: After the battle, Alesha hears the warriors' deeds and shouts out each new war name.
events.quote: she shouted the name for the horde to hear—with never a moment's hesitation.

events.summary: Three warriors testify that the nameless orc saved their lives, and Alesha rebukes him for thinking his deeds are not glorious enough, telling him to learn his place before choosing a name.
events.quote: When you learn what your place among the Mardu is, then you can choose a name.

events.summary: The orc declares he knows Alesha and names her 'Alesha, Who Smiles at Death,' and the Mardu shout her name.
events.quote: and I call you Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

relations.note: She is the young khan of the Mardu.
relations.quote: The young khan of the Mardu sat poised at the front of her horde

relations.note: She fights and kills Kolaghan's brood.
relations.quote: These were the dragons they sought, the filthy brood of the monstrous Kolaghan.
Six of Kolaghan's brood would never prey on the Mardu again.

relations.note: Both fought beside and owe their lives to the same orc.
relations.quote: My friend saved my life, throwing himself onto a dragon's head when it was about to take me in its jaws.
